mfg-colorsteel-environment.claim: COLORSTEEL separates NZ environmental exposure into categories and changes product/warranty/maintenance recommendations with coastal severity.
mfg-colorsteel-environment.applicability: COLORSTEEL products only. Site position, prevailing wind and local conditions can alter the environmental category; use the current warranty guide.

mfg-colorsteel-maintenance.claim: COLORSTEEL calls for regular cleaning/inspection, particularly for areas not naturally rain-washed and in more severe coastal environments.
mfg-colorsteel-maintenance.applicability: COLORSTEEL products and the stated warranty conditions; maintenance frequency varies by environment.

mfg-dimond-dp955-pitch.claim: Dimond publishes a 3° minimum pitch and 955 mm nominal cover for DP955.
mfg-dimond-dp955-pitch.applicability: DP955 only; full span, fixing, flashing and long-sheet requirements still apply.

mfg-ri-trimrib-pitch.claim: Roofing Industries states a 3° minimum pitch for Trimrib.
mfg-ri-trimrib-pitch.applicability: Trimrib family only; use the current manufacturer technical documents for the selected variant and project.

mfg-gerard-antica-pitch.topic: pressed metal tile pitch and cover
mfg-gerard-antica-pitch.claim: Gerard publishes a 12° minimum roof pitch, 0.47 m² effective cover per tile and approximately 6.4 kg/m² for Antica.
mfg-gerard-antica-pitch.applicability: Antica only; other Gerard profiles have different pitch/coverage limits.

mfg-gerard-system-scope.claim: The current BRANZ appraisal treats Gerard pressed-metal tiles as systems installed with underlay, battens, flashings and specified fixing conditions, not as a tile-only product decision.
mfg-gerard-system-scope.applicability: Gerard systems within the appraisal scope and current technical literature.

mfg-nuralite-tpo-falls.claim: Nuralite states a 1:80 minimum fall for Nuraply TPO and recommends steeper falls of 1:40 on plywood and 1:60 on concrete or metal substrates to reduce ponding.
mfg-nuralite-tpo-falls.applicability: Nuraply TPO system and its CodeMark/technical requirements; design drainage and substrate conditions still need project-specific confirmation.

mfg-viking-system-selection.claim: Viking separates membrane systems by roof build-up and context, including cold roofs, insulated/warm roofs and retrofit situations.
mfg-viking-system-selection.applicability: Viking systems only; system selection must follow the relevant certification, substrate and applicator requirements.

mfg-viking-torch-applicator.claim: Viking states its Torch-On systems are complete proprietary systems installed by Viking Approved Applicators and supported by product-specific appraisal/CodeMark documentation.
mfg-viking-torch-applicator.applicability: Viking Torch-On systems only; warranty and certification conditions apply.

mfg-colorsteel-product-choice.claim: COLORSTEEL positions MAXAM for most NZ environments and ALTIMATE for more extreme marine, volcanic and highly corrosive conditions.
mfg-colorsteel-product-choice.applicability: COLORSTEEL products only. Final selection depends on the current environment classification and warranty guide.
